result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it covers affiliates and contractors acting on Company’s behalf, makes the royalty-free perpetual licence irrevocable, and permits transfer to a successor. Subscription termination terms are inapplicable to this perpetual, royalty-free grant. The changes are targeted and preserve the original use rights and business-purpose limitation. Drafting is generally professional, though the inherited phrase “create, derivative version” remains grammatically defective and should read “create derivative versions of.”
